title: Dumping Waste to Protect Homes from Wildfire
description:
Nearly 25 tons of brush, trees and other organic waste were removed by residents in the Kensington and Talmadge communities during the Kensington Fire Safe Council’s semi-annual dump-a-thon! 👏 

The event has been running for 13 years. This was the first collaboration with San Diego Fire-Rescue and the City’s Environmental Services Department: insidesandiego.org/dump-thon-nets-nearly-25-tons-organic-waste-partnership-fire-rescue-aims-protect-homes-wildfire
